title: FB-036 include image subtitle sidecars in no-mutation snapshots
summary: Fix FR-049 by making WebView browser no-mutation snapshots watch image subtitle sidecar files.
reason: Worker finding W11-002 showed the no-mutation suffix allow-list missed VobSub/PGS-style sidecars such as .idx, .sub, and .sup.
behavior_before: Browser smoke no-mutation snapshots ignored image subtitle sidecars, so tests could miss creation, deletion, or modification of those files.
behavior_after: Browser smoke no-mutation snapshots watch .idx, .sub, and .sup sidecars and fail on their creation, deletion, or modification.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_browser_smoke_support -q passed, 8 tests; tests.webview.test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke -q passed.
